Select: canonical_smiles, substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key, organism, enzyme_name. Source: metabolism, compound_structures, compound_records. Join: metabolism.substrate_record_id = compound_records.record_id; compound_records.molregno = compound_structures.molregno. Filter: enzyme_name = 'CYP2C19'. Sort: canonical_smiles ASC, substrate_compound_name ASC, parent_compound_name ASC, met_conversion ASC, pathway_key ASC, organism ASC, enzyme_name ASC. Limit: 200.
